title: 梵语文学语义变化的计算方法研究
summary: 本文探讨历时词嵌入方法在梵语等低资源古代语言中的适用性。作者构建了覆盖四个经典时期的270万词元语料库，使用神经字节级连音拆分器和词形还原器恢复词边界，并训练各时期词嵌入。在21个可测试的语义变化中，19个方向与文献学考证一致（符号检验，p=0.00011）。
summary_en: This paper tests whether diachronic word embeddings transfer to Sanskrit, an ancient low-resource language with sandhi, inflection, compounding, and polysemy. The author assembles a 2.7M-token corpus across four canonical periods, recovers word boundaries with a neural byte-level sandhi splitter and lemmatizer, and trains per-period embeddings. Of 21 testable shifts, 19 move in the philologically attested direction (sign test, p=0.00011).
